description: This is a PHP source file implementing a command-line interface (CLI) tool for installing the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It defines installation procedures, configuration, database setup, and validation routines, encapsulated within the CliInstall class. The script handles command-line arguments, performs environment and extension checks, creates database tables, inserts initial data, and writes configuration files.
